text:
Hello,

I am planning to hire the Lindqvist 1800 for my sister's wedding day and I was wondering if you could prepare it for collection. We would like to pick it up on 13th August 2027 at 2:00 pm and return it on 16/08/2027 at 17:00. It would be convenient if you could bring it to Hollowmere Abbey, where we will be located, and collect it from there afterwards. I have also included a copy of my driving licence.

Best wishes,
Victor Quillfeather
+70 412 568 5801
